The capture package renders the page in a managed browser, so the figures that the plain fetch could never see arrive as inline SVG with their styles inlined onto the elements — exactly the shape this fixture models.

Every chart here was drawn by the page's own scripts at render time; what the reader receives is the serialized result, colors resolved and scripts gone, and the prose around the charts carries the article's argument.

The residuals concentrate where the two series cross, and the remaining prose exists so the article body stands on its own paragraph mass rather than on the figures it happens to carry.
